llm_response.reason: The website mimics the design and branding of a legitimate fashion store (Elena Mirò) but uses a misleading domain (francoiselenfant.shop) unrelated to the official brand. There is no genuine company or contact information present, nor detailed customer privacy statements. The language attempts to create false trust and mirrors typical scam tactics, such as promising 'safe purchases' and 'SSL encryption,' while showing ambiguous business legitimacy. All these match the Fake Online Shopping scam category.
